findings.source_fact_verified: Picker may accept an occupied coordinate, which is replaced by a free neighboring coordinate before movement.
findings.reason: The claim conflates selected coordinate with actual landing destination. Current 跃向…空地 describes the landing, which code enforces via findFreeGrid and block_move checks before move; it does not explicitly prohibit choosing an occupied coordinate. No objective first-tier false mechanism established. Clarifying picker behavior may improve wording but concerns an unchanged destination subclause, outside the accepted opening-action/stat-bonus repairs. At cycle3 retain only a nonblocking successor clarity note, not another FIX.
